alt_text: Detect blinks faster with linear attention transformers. The page features a large illustration of an eye, introducing the topic of fast blink detection using linear attention transformers.
This page describes eye blink detection for safety and security. It shows the BlinkLinMulT multimodal transformer architecture used for blink presence and eye state recognition.
Challenges in handling noisy data and short blinks. The image shows head pose angle dependence of BlinkLinMulT for blink presence detection.
The BlinkLinMulT architecture shows cross-modal transformers fusing RGB and landmark features into a linear multimodal transformer to estimate blinks for each eye.
Superior F1 scores on RT-BENEimg and TalkingFace datasets show ResNet50 outperformed DenseNet121, and training on combined datasets improved scores.
